scope: Screen a newly surfaced open-source B-rep kernel and its claimed ACadRust bridge for a usable analytic-control producer route or independent DWG/DXF/ACIS semantic evidence.

method.evidenceBoundary: Package documentation establishes the project's published claims, stage/roadmap descriptions, and caveats only. It does not establish source-level API completeness, reproducible B-rep construction, usable serialization, third-party acceptance, or libdxfrw behavior.

evidence.topic: Formus release maturity and public example readiness
observed: docs.rs lists Formus 0.1.0 as published 2026-09-02 and describes it as very early stage.
The package page reports zero documented examples out of nine items.
The basic prismatic-body example is explicitly labeled Planned API.
The roadmap places the bidirectional ACadRust SAT/SAB bridge in Phase 6 after kernel foundations and geometry milestones.
evidence.planUse: Discovery-only candidate; do not rely on it as a ready control author, serializer, kernel, or producer until an exact source/release provides a working API and reproducible output.

evidence.topic: Shared ACadRust I/O lineage and per-entity qualification boundary
observed: Formus describes ACadRust as its native DWG/DXF/ACIS engine and lists an ACadRust SAT/SAB bridge.
ACadRust advertises format-level version read/write paths but explicitly says entity availability varies by file version and points to a tested compatibility matrix.
No package-page evidence demonstrates an independent writer/parser/kernel round-trip or a Formus bridge accepted by a third-party reader.
evidence.planUse: If a future exact route is evaluated, separate kernel geometry from ACadRust serialization, pin the full source/dependency/feature/toolchain graph, and inspect output with an independent parser plus analytic expected values. Do not count self-round-trip as an independent pass.

nextActions: Continue local implementation slices with focused fast tests; do not install or build Formus per slice.
At a future composed-checkpoint preflight, confirm exact source/license, public B-rep API, bridge availability, feature graph, and ability to emit a from-scratch analytic control.
If runnable, independently inspect generated bytes and validate exact geometry and operation results; otherwise retain NOT_AVAILABLE and continue.

planDelta.summary: Added a route-readiness screen for Formus and its ACadRust bridge, excluding it from implementation and semantic-evidence gates until a working release/source route and independent byte/geometry checks are demonstrated.
